text.en: Supplied USDC bears this market's collateral risk; verify stops after each upgrade until re-pinned.
`supply` pulls exactly the amount of USDC from the Safe into the market with `transferFrom`.

The market held 343.7 million USDC of supply on 2026-11-21, and between 327 and 427 million at every monthly reading over the year. It is old and large, not sudden; supply is about 20% below its December 2025 reading.

recommendation.en: Acceptable; check the market's size and utilization in Compound's app before a large supply.

pastTxsConclusion.en: The Safes found supplied with `supply` alone after an earlier unlimited approval; none of them batched the exact approval. One EOA's supply repaid a borrow first, so its balance rose 5,501.99 USDC less, which verify gives MISMATCH.
